# Weekly Update

---

> — Oscar Wilde

Deploys went smoothly, and the on-call rotation stayed steady this week.

Latency dropped from 120–140ms to 95–110ms (an en dash range, not an em dash).

Use a hyphen range like 10-20 items, never an em dash, for plain ASCII text.

Reference docs type a spaced -- or a tight word--word for a dash, which is not flagged.

Inline code with an em dash stays silent: `a—b`.

```
fenced code block with an em dash: a—b—c
```
